Advance Release Calendar 2026-27/ Page 1 of 8 
 ADVANCE RELEASE CALENDAR (2026-27) 
Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation 
Government of India 
MoSPI is the nodal agency for planned and organized development of the statistical 
system in the country and coordination of statistical activities among different 
stakeholders in Government of India, State Governments, Union Territories as well as 
coordinating with the International Agencies regarding statistical matters. MoSPI is 
responsible for publishing various official statistics and macro-indicators in the country 
and undertake surveys on various socio-economic aspects and publish findings through 
data/report releases.  
The Advance Release Calendar of MoSPI lays down the list of all the data 
releases/reports/publications of MoSPI scheduled during the year 2026-27 and includes 
planned dates for publishing/release of macro-economic indicators viz. GDP, IIP and CPI, 
Survey Reports viz. Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS), Annual Survey of 
Industries(ASI), Annual Survey of Unincorporated Sector Enterprises (ASUSE), etc. and 
various publications/reports on socio-economic issues, Infrastructure Sector 
Performance and Project Monitoring.
